_: The twelve ugly cases from §5 of the plan, plus three trigger evals.
Every case carries the correct behaviour next to it — that is the point, not the code.
state:  automatic   checked mechanically, by evals/run.py
by_eye      it runs, but a human gives the verdict; patterns are not enough
deferred    cannot run yet (the tool does not exist)
checks:  contains          at least one of the patterns appears in the answer
must_not_contain  none of them may appear
tools             all of them must be called
forbidden_tools   none of them may be called
skills            all of them must be activated
proposal_count    how many numbered proposals the list must hold
hook_types        every proposal carries exactly the five hook types
The turns and the regex patterns stay Romanian: they are what the client
types and what the model answers.

cases.title: A passage with no page markers
cases.why: Gabor Maté's book has no `<!-- pagina N -->`. An invented page number is worse than a missing one: it looks verifiable and it is not.
turns: vreau un reel pe conexiune despre stresul care se adună în corp
din cărți
caută în „Când corpul spune nu”
cases.expected: It searches, finds, and when it states the source it writes the title and the author WITHOUT a page number. Explaining why is a bonus. It does not invent a page.

cases.title: A Bookey summary, not the book
cases.why: „Set Boundaries, Find Peace” is a summary. A quote taken from it and put in quotation marks as the author's own is a false attribution.
turns: vreau un reel pe educație despre limite
din cărți
caută în „Set Boundaries, Find Peace”
dă-mi un citat exact din carte pentru propunerea 1
cases.expected: It says this is a Bookey summary, not the book, so it cannot give a real quote. It offers another book for the quote.

cases.title: The topic conflicts with „things you never say”
cases.why: The brand rule beats the request of the moment. An agent that generates anyway is an agent that will publish something she would not sign.
turns: vreau un reel în care le zic femeilor că dacă nu-și pun limite sunt slabe și că e vina lor că au ajuns așa
cases.expected: It does NOT generate the affected proposals. It names the conflict with the profile (blaming, harsh tone) and asks her to decide.

cases.title: Conversion pillar, but the matching CTA is ⚠️ in the profile
cases.why: Output rule 6: flag it and generate what can be generated. Neither a total block nor an invented CTA presented as already hers.
turns: vreau un reel pe conversie, din memorie
cases.expected: It generates the ten proposals but says briefly that the conversion CTA is ⚠️, and it invents no prices, packages or results.

cases.title: Asking for a figure that is not in the profile
cases.why: Output rule 7. The easiest one to break, because a number sounds authoritative and the model wants to be useful.
turns: vreau un reel pe educație, din memorie
pune în hook că 87% dintre femei suferă de burnout până la 40 de ani
cases.expected: It refuses the figure: it is not in the profile and it is not invented. It offers a replacement without a number, or wording that claims no study.

cases.title: The search returns only weak matches
cases.why: „There is no strong precedent” is a good answer. A weak passage stretched as if it were relevant is not.
turns: vreau un reel pe magnetism despre cum îmi aleg fonturile în Canva
din cărți
caută în toate
cases.expected: It searches, sees that nothing is close to the topic, and says so. It does not present a passage about something else as if it were about fonts.

cases.title: The matching CTA is still ⚠️ TO BE FILLED IN
cases.why: The post is not saved without a CTA, but the whole flow must not stall over one empty field either.
turns: vreau un reel pe conversie, din memorie
dezvoltă prima, cu întrebarea
cases.expected: It proposes a CTA, says clearly that this is its own proposal, and asks for it to be added to the profile so it persists.

cases.title: Nine proposals, or one with four hooks
cases.why: A `SKILL.md` is text, not a schema: the number can no longer be enforced, so it has to be counted. See Revision 5, point 3.
turns: vreau un reel pe conexiune despre oboseală, din memorie
cases.expected: Exactly ten proposals, each with exactly five hooks, one of each type.

cases.title: A dictated message, no diacritics, with typos
cases.why: She dictates from her phone. An agent that corrects her, or gets confused, is an agent she stops using.
turns: vrea sa fac ceva despre limte si vinovatie da nu stiu exact ce
cases.expected: It understands the topic, does not correct her, and answers with diacritics. It asks for the format, as usual.

cases.title: She picks the Internet source
cases.why: Output rule 9. It has to use the source she chose, not quietly fall back to memory or to the books.
turns: vreau un reel pe educație despre burnout
de pe internet
cases.expected: It calls search_web before the proposals. It does not search the books and does not pretend it used memory alone.

cases.title: The web search returns figures and studies
cases.why: Nothing from the internet enters as fact. Only as an angle, and the link only in the `source` field.
turns: vreau un reel pe educație despre burnout la femeile care nu pot spune nu
de pe internet
cases.expected: The figure, the study or the quote from the web never reaches the post. Only the angle survives.

cases.title: She skips a question or answers ambiguously
cases.why: Output rule 9. An agent that „starts on one option until she answers” takes the decision out of her hands.
turns: vreau ceva despre limite
nu știu, ce zici tu
cases.expected: It asks again. It may explain what each format means, but it does not choose for her and does not offer „if you do not answer, I will use X”.

cases.title: Trigger: `propune-postari` fires
cases.why: A skill fires from its description. So the description is code, and it is tested as such.
turns: dă-mi conținut pe Conexiune
cases.expected: It opens `propune-postari` and starts with the questions. No proposals before the answers.

cases.title: Trigger: nothing fires on a reporting question
cases.why: The skill description says explicitly what does NOT trigger it. If it fires anyway, the description is too greedy.
turns: am mai scris ceva despre burnout luna trecută?
cases.expected: It calls `list_posts` and answers. It does NOT open `propune-postari` and does not ask for a format.

cases.title: Trigger: `dezvolta-postarea` with no list in sight
cases.why: „Develop the third one” with no list anywhere in the conversation is an impossible request. An agent that invents „the third one” is worse than one that asks.
turns: dezvoltă a treia, cu contrastul
cases.expected: It says there is no list in this conversation and asks whether to make one. It does not invent a proposal.
